CREATE function CDN.KwotaLimituAkwizytora( @p_FrS integer, @p_AkwFirma integer, @p_AkwNumer integer)
Returns varchar(255)
AS
BEGIN
declare @retval varchar(255); declare @frsid integer; declare @limit Decimal(28,4); declare @c int declare @temp_table Table (FRS_ID int unique,Poziom int)
INSERT INTO @temp_table SELECT B.FRS_ID,1 FROM cdn.frmstruktura AS A join cdn.frmstruktura AS B ON B.FRS_GidTyp=A.FRS_GroTyp and B.FRS_GidFirma=A.FRS_GroFirma and B.FRS_GidNumer=A.FRS_GroNumer and B.FRS_GidLp=A.FRS_GroLp AND A.FRS_ID=@p_FrS SET @c=0 WHILE @c<>(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @temp_table) BEGIN SET @c=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @temp_table) INSERT INTO @temp_table SELECT B.frs_id,Poziom+1 FROM cdn.frmstruktura AS A join cdn.frmstruktura AS B ON B.FRS_GidTyp=A.FRS_GroTyp AND B.FRS_GidFirma=A.FRS_GroFirma AND B.FRS_GidNumer=A.FRS_GroNumer AND B.FRS_GidLp=A.FRS_GroLp JOIN @temp_table AS stt ON A.FRS_ID=stt.FRS_ID AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @temp_table AS stt2 WHERE stt2.FRS_ID=B.FRS_ID) END
SELECT @frsid=KLS_FrSID,@limit=KLS_KwotaLimitu FROM cdn.kntlimitys WHERE KLS_KntTyp=32 AND KLS_KntFirma=@p_AkwFirma AND KLS_KntNumer=@p_AkwNumer AND KLS_FrsID=@p_FrS
SET @limit=IsNull(@limit,0) SET @frsid=IsNull(@frsid,0)
IF(@limit=0) BEGIN SELECT top 1 @frsid=KLS_FrSID,@limit=KLS_KwotaLimitu FROM cdn.kntlimitys JOIN @temp_table on KLS_FrSID=FRS_ID WHERE KLS_KntTyp=32 AND KLS_KntFirma=@p_AkwFirma AND KLS_KntNumer=@p_AkwNumer AND (SELECT count(*) FROM @temp_table WHERE FRS_ID=KLS_FrSID)>0 ORDER BY Poziom; END
SET @limit=IsNull(@limit,0) SET @frsid=IsNull(@frsid,0)
SET @retval=cast(@limit as varchar)+':'+cast(@frsid as varchar)
RETURN @retval
END
